basic_info.description: Chic Condominium with Stunning City Views  This beautifully remodeled condominium offers million-dollar views of the city and bay in a compact yet stylish package. Perfectly designed for modern living, the space combines sophistication with functionality.  The bright living area features large windows that frame the sweeping views, creating a stunning backdrop for everyday life. The sleek kitchen boasts updated appliances, quartz countertops, and smart storage solutions, making it both practical and inviting.  The cozy bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, complemented by a well-appointed bathroom with contemporary finishes. This gem also includes access to a private deck, ideal for relaxing or entertaining.  With its breathtaking views and thoughtful upgrades, this condominium is an exceptional opportunity to own a piece of the city's skyline.
